name.zh: 会伸缩的 Tab 滑块

summary.zh: 切换 Tab 时，底下的滑块先伸长到同时盖住起点和终点，再收回到目标，像被拽过去一样。文字颜色等滑块快到了才变。
summary.en: When switching tabs, the pill first stretches to cover both the old and new tab, then contracts onto the target, like it is being pulled. Label color swaps only as the pill arrives.

technique.zh: 三段关键帧：起点 → {x: 两者最左, width: 跨度×0.92, offset: .42} → 终点，动 translateX + width（不用 scaleX，避免圆角被拉扁）。
technique.en: Three keyframes: start → {x: leftmost, width: span×0.92, offset: .42} → end, animating translateX + width (not scaleX, so the radius never squashes).

adapt.zh: 按钮数量随意加；正式用时删掉 play() 里的自动轮播 setInterval。
adapt.en: Add as many tabs as you like; remove the autoplay setInterval in play().
